critical_code_review_comments: LoginPage.js line 172 now correctly declares <form onSubmit={handleLogin} className="space-y-4" noValidate>. With noValidate present, the browser skips HTML5 constraint checks and the JS handler runs the regex + toast.error path as designed. Email input still uses type='email' which preserves the email keyboard hint on mobile - good UX.
Client-side regex /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/ catches missing @, missing domain, missing TLD, and whitespace cases before any network round-trip. Backend EmailStr remains source of truth.
Login error path correctly extracts error.response.data.detail and falls back to a generic 'Login failed' message; never lets an unhandled error blank the page. Confirmed visually.
